thesis: Use repeatable meals and flexible principles to support a personal training goal.
summary: Bloom walks through a high-protein day, home cooking, lifting and running. Five habits are protein, daily movement, concentrating carbs near workouts, a ninety/ten flexibility rule and a protein-rich sweet dessert. Convenience, repetitive meals and pre-cooked ingredients reduce preparation time. He tracks macros approximately and ends by acknowledging a carb-counting error.

insights.quote: I prioritize ease over just about everything

review_status: Codex editorial draft; complete local transcript read; claims not independently verified
synthesis_method: Direct Codex extraction from complete local transcript; exact quotations verified locally
context_and_limits: Personal diet and reported body-fat change do not establish effectiveness or suitability for others. Protein targets, fat-loss mechanisms, timing, heat exposure and digestion claims are unverified. His high training load and available resources matter. The spoken ground-beef fat/protein ratio appears reversed; do not normalize it into nutrition advice.
review_changes: Adds implementation convenience, explicit flexibility and tracking imperfection; keeps training-specific intake and heat practices separate from general recommendations.
